newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Enterprise cut to "hold".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Enterprise cut to "hold".

text.p: Enterprise Oil Plc was cut to a "hold" from a "buy" at SBC Warburg, market sources said on Monday.
The stock was down 3-1/2p at 584 by 1345 GMT. Warburg analyst Rob Arnott declined comment on reasons for the change.
The move comes after a sharp recent advance in Enterprise shares, which closed at a year's high of 588p on Friday -- up from 398p at the end of 1995.
Last week the stock extended its rally amid positive feedback from an analyst visit to the company's Italian operations.
Analysts at Robert Fleming were said to have put a value of 800p on Enterprise shares on the basis of a valuation of its Italian reserves.
